verdict.rationale: There is some evidence that Namecheap hosts DNS for registered domains. It publishes an official Terraform provider for domain DNS configuration that can manage individual records, and its own registrar-servers.com nameservers appear in RDAP data. Dynamic DNS updates are documented and praised by a community member as an included extra. Nothing in the pack covers the specific breadth or quality this story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of support for every record type, evidence of low or configurable TTL minimums, any documentation or hands-on reports on the DNS management UI, and independent corroboration of the DNS hosting feature set.
